name: Bovinae Calf
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
When these monsters stampede, the sound is of rolling thunder, and their movements are like an avalanche crashing through the flatlands.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

BOVINAE CALF
CR 7

XP 3,200
N Large magical beast (earth)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +7 natural, –1 size)
hp 68 (8d10+24); DR 10/bludgeoning
Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +5; Resist all 5

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., charge 60 ft.
Melee 2 hooves +10 (1d6+12/x3 plus trip) or gore +10 (2d6+18/19–20)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks avalanche stride (2d6+24/x2)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 15, Con 17, Int 3, Wis 16, Cha 7
Base Atk +8; CMB +15 (+17 to trip); CMD 27 (31 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack (used), Vicious Stomp
Skills Disable Device +17, Perception +14, Stealth –2
SQ break

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Avalanche Stride (Ex)

When the bovinae makes a trample attack, it counts as a stampede of 3 Large Creatures (it still only takes up a 10-ft. space). While stampeding, the bovinae can trample Large-sized or smaller foes (Reflex DC 20). It deals double its hoof damage on a hit (or x4 on a critical hit), and if the target is knocked prone, the bovinae gets an attack of opportunity against it before continuing forward.

Break (Ex)

A bovinae applies its Strength to Disable Device checks in place of Dexterity. If it succeeds, it breaks the device.
